title: Here Are the 2026 CMA Awards Winners: Full List (Updating Live)
summary: Who will be the biggest winner at the 2026 CMA Awards? Follow along with Billboard's updating winners list.
contentText:
Going into Wednesday night’s (Nov. 18) CMA Awards , Ella Langley is the leading nominee with nine nods — including in the top category of entertainer of the year for her first time. But who will leave the night’s biggest winner? You can follow along with Billboard all night as we update our 2026 CMA Awards winners list live.

Lainey Wilson returns as host, and Taylor Swift is performing on the show for the first time in 13 years. Langley secured an early CMA win when her blockbuster hit “Choosin’ Texas” took home music video of the year, as announced on Good Morning America , and musical event of the year went to “McArthur,” Tim McGraw’s collab with HARDY, Eric Church and Morgan Wallen.
